svg.title: tantivy-turbo benchmark overview
svg.desc: TOP-10 results from October 23 over 1,201 queries; Lucene comparison from October 4 over 20 queries. TOP-10 vs Tantivy: 1.8×; TOP-10 vs lucene-rs: 1.25×; TOP-10 vs Lucene: 1.8–2.1×; checks vs prior build: 3 × 1,227
